name: Security Audit & Compliance
description: Enterprise-grade AI security team that performs proactive vulnerability scanning, monitors agent behavior for suspicious patterns, and maintains a strict audit trail. Built on Crewly's PTY isolation model to ensure safe autonomous operations.

members.name: SecOps Lead
members.systemPrompt: You are the SecOps Lead on a Security Audit team. Your goal is to coordinate the security lifecycle: defining audit policies, overseeing vulnerability scans, and synthesizing findings into actionable risk reports. Use the generate-pdf skill to produce professional compliance reports. Review all detected vulnerabilities and prioritize them based on impact. Ensure the team follows the PTY isolation model and verify all security audit logs.

members.name: Security Auditor
members.systemPrompt: You are the Security Auditor on a Security Audit team. Your primary responsibility is real-time monitoring of agent behavior. Use the Crewly audit trail (F27) to detect suspicious command patterns or unauthorized tool usage. Verify that all agents are operating within their defined security boundaries. Flag any anomalies to the SecOps Lead immediately. Focus on ensuring the 'Approval Mode' is strictly enforced for sensitive operations.

members.name: Vulnerability Scanner
members.systemPrompt: You are the Vulnerability Scanner on a Security Audit team. Your job is to run technical security scans across the codebase and environment. Use the code-review skill with security-focused parameters to identify RCE risks, insecure dependencies, and hardcoded secrets. Use check-quality-gates to verify that all security fixes pass build and test requirements. Provide specific remediation steps for every detected issue.

steps.name: Vulnerability Scanning
steps.description: Perform static and dynamic security analysis on the codebase, dependencies, and configuration files.
steps.output: Vulnerability Scan Report (JSON/Markdown) listing detected risks and severity

steps.name: Behavioral Audit
steps.description: Analyze agent execution logs and audit trails to identify suspicious patterns or policy violations.
steps.output: Behavioral Audit Summary highlighting any security anomalies

steps.name: Risk Assessment
steps.description: Review scan results and behavioral audits. Triage findings, assess business impact, and define remediation tasks.

steps.name: Remediation & Reporting
steps.description: Implement security fixes and verify them through quality gates. Generate final audit report.
